name: Fusb302B → Request Voltage
description: This action changes the voltage to request from the source. When a source is attached, the component negotiates a new power contract right away, following the same rules as `request_voltage` in the configuration (see [Power Negotiation](https://esphome.io/components/fusb302b/#power-negotiation)). When no source is attached, the new voltage is used at the next attach.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the FUSB302B component. Required when more than one `fusb302b` is configured.

config_entries.label: Voltage
config_entries.description: The voltage in volts to request, from `5` to `20`.
